svg.text: MaxMulSK vs MpGEMM vs Apple Accelerate
Single-thread FP32 GEMM, Apple M4. Higher is better. Measured 2026-09-10; every implementation returns the same result on all 35 shapes.
K is the long axis, N = 512

Shapes labelled M×K×N. DeepSeek and LLaMA IDs follow Table III of the MpGEMM paper, which lists them as M, N, K. Reps calibrated on the slowest entrant; call order rotated as a cyclic Latin square; median of per-call timings.
MaxMulSK 2x2 and 4x1 are omitted: 1x4 is the fastest of the three on 33 of 35 shapes. Full data in vs_mpgemm.csv.
